scope: Two cmd/tbound test fixtures corrected. No production code changed. No commit. Logs and manifest on F: at TBoundAssets/recovery-20261015/service-fixture-regressions.
status: Both fixtures fixed. Focused RED reproduced on the untouched committed snapshot; focused GREEN in normal and no-new-privs contexts; full cmd/tbound unit passed. Full cmd/tbound race failed once on attempt 1 with one intermittent test outside the owned files (cause not identified); the next two full race runs on the same validated tree passed. The first race attempt is therefore not green, and the race gate is not established by a single clean run.
validated_tree: Extracted a7ac97e tree (402 files; every blob id equal to git ls-tree -r a7ac97e, checked before and after overlay) with ONLY the two corrected test files overlaid. Uncommitted working-tree changes, including the concurrent D14 WIP under supervisor/internal/workflowrecovery, are excluded by construction. The repo status at run start is logs/p1-repo-status.log (56 entries).

fixes.cause: After request-blocking completed, the request journal's begin() refuses any new admission while a prior lacks independent settlement. The test server installs no settlementVerifier, so request-disconnect got ErrPiServiceUnresolvedPrior, was never durably accepted, and the test failed at line 427 ('disconnect canceled or lost the accepted request', exists=false).
fixes.change: The disconnect case runs on a second newPiServiceTestServer with no prior work. The handler is shared through a runTask variable. Expected handler calls for the disconnect case change from 2 to 1. The busy refusal, the accepted and terminal wait, and the replay-without-rerun checks are unchanged. The gate is unchanged and no settlement fallback was added.

fixes.cause: The fixture set AdmissionRecordHash with digestBytes, which is sha256:-prefixed. validWorkflowCatalogEntry requires validBareWorkflowDigest (64 lowercase hex, the journal record hash domain), so the entry was rejected before any fresh, recovery, deadline or uncertain-authorization assertion ran ('fixture entry is not a valid production workflow catalog record'). The other digest fields are correctly prefixed (validDigestText) and were not changed.
fixes.change: AdmissionRecordHash = bareWorkflowDigest(digestBytes(label)). All assertions are unchanged. No production code was changed; with the fixture corrected, all three subcases pass and print their markers.

other_changes: docs/evidence/d09-stable-snapshot-validation-20261015.json: prose only, three fields. baseline_comparison skip_comparison.note now says the no-new-privs runs also SKIP TestD09CellTemplateDraftIsNotAdmissible. limitations: 'The D09 scope gates pass.' now says they do not pass (d09_scope_status failed, skip_focus_no_new_privs_passes false). The supplementary-groups sentence now says the registered profile does not register those groups, which is the skip reason. The phrase 'satisfies the xattr scanner profile' the brief named was not present in the file; the equivalent 'is not the profile the xattr check tests' claim was the one corrected. No hashes, results or statuses were changed.

intermittent_failure.observed: Attempt 1 only. The recover child r1 exited 1, expected 74. Its error was ErrOwnerFence 'owner process incarnation changed', raised at internal/workflowrecovery/sqlite_linux.go:1126 in the committed snapshot. revalidate compares currentProcessIncarnation() with the stored owner incarnation.
intermittent_failure.ordering: Runs at line 120 of the attempt-1 log, before the owned pi test (line 318) and pin test (line 436), so the overlaid tests do not run before it in that process.
intermittent_failure.history: PASS in D09 logs 05 (unit), 06 (race), 07 (unit, no-new-privs) and 08 (race, no-new-privs); PASS in the unit run of this validation (u1).
intermittent_failure.reruns: Validated tree: focused race x10 10/10 PASS; full race x2 PASS, 0 FAIL, 0 DATA RACE. Untouched a7ac97e: focused race x10 10/10 PASS; full race x1 with a status set identical to D09 06.
intermittent_failure.assessment: Intermittent, not reproduced in 13 focused and 3 full race reruns. Cause not identified. currentProcessIncarnation reads boot id, start time, PID-namespace inode, euid and a cgroup digest, and none of these is visibly nondeterministic within one process. Not shown to come from the owned edits, but not proven unrelated.
intermittent_failure.follow_up: Owner of internal/workflowrecovery: loop the test under -race with a large count and log the failing child's incarnation against the stored one to see which field diverges.
